title: Etale descent of the finite adic levels before Isom reduction
statement: Let X,Y be schemes, g:Y→X, d an adic coefficient datum on A [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], M an adic tower on X [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], and U in Y.ProEt. Put C=AdicCompletion(d.ideal,A), J=d.ideal*C, B_n=C/J^(n+1), and q_n:B_(n+1)→B_n the actual quotient map. Let K_n in D(B_n) be cohomologically bounded with finite module cohomology, and suppose separately for each n that the constantAdicQuotientRealization of K_n is locally isomorphic to the pulled-back M.level n on a covering sieve of U. There exist bounded etale B_n-module complexes D_n on U.left with finite locally constant cohomology and arrows delta_n:D_(n+1)→Res(q_n) D_n whose canonical restrictions to every etale object [def-weil-pbc-etale-isomorphism-normalization-arrow] are universal. For every universal algebraic arrow k:E→Res(q_n)E', the canonical restriction of constant(k) to every etale object is universal as well. For every map of etale objects, restriction of a pair of isomorphisms satisfying the normalization square for constant(k) and delta_n again satisfies that square, under the canonical inverse-image coefficient mates. The geometric stalks of the sheaf of actual local derived isomorphisms from constant(K_n) to D_n [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf] are nonempty. For every V in U.left.ProEt and W→ProEt.mk(V.hom≫U.hom), there are finite-coefficient realization functors F_n from fixed B_n-module complexes on V.left.ProEt to actual pulled-back quotient-module complexes on W.left, isomorphisms model_n(E):F_n(localComparison constant(E))≅constantAdicQuotientRealization(E) for every algebraic E, and actual_n:F_n(localComparison D_n)≅pullback(M.level n). Writing H_n for restriction along the actual constant-completion projection, there is a coefficient interchange alpha_n:Res(q_n)⋙F_(n+1)⋙H_(n+1)≅F_n⋙H_n. Its square on delta_n is exactly the actual restricted transition of M, and its square on constant(k), for every algebraic k:E→Res(q_n)E', is exactly constantAdicFiniteRealization(lisseTowerAlgebraArrow(k)), after the model comparisons and constantAdicQuotientRightIso [lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison]. The algebraic arrow uses the specified mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and restrictScalarsComp' compositors. These are precisely the fields and equations of LisseTowerEtaleDescent. No source normalization maps are supplied to this statement. No Isom reduction maps, weakly contractible evaluations, compatible sections, or covers common to all n are selected.

proof.text: At each n apply one-level descent to M.level n and K_n. Choose the descended levels and their boundedness, finite-local-constancy, geometric Isom-stalk and actual-comparison witnesses independently in n.
Apply normalization descent to these fixed etale levels and their actual comparisons. This uses boundedness but no local markings or stalk assertions.

Assemble the original descent record. For restriction_square, apply the proved generic normalizationSquareTransport to the canonical etale coefficient mate, the two local restriction compositors, and the constant and actual coherence equations. The transported conjugates are exactly localIsomorphismMap. Copy the remaining normalization/realization fields and the independently obtained level/stalk fields.

theorem lisse_tower_etale_descent
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (U : Y.ProEt)
    (K : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1}
      (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
        (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))))
    (hbounded : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (K n)))
    (hfinite : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Module.Finite
      (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
          (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
          (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))) q).obj (K n)))
    (hmodels : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧
      ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w →
        Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj (K n) ≅
          (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
            ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))) :
    Nonempty (LisseTowerEtaleDescent X Y g d M U K)
